description: This PHP script contains functions for checking database settings during the installation process of SuiteCRM, including validation of database credentials, names, and connection tests, as well as session management for installation parameters.

classes.name: DBManager
classes.description: Abstract class/interface for database management, used via getInstallDbInstance()

methods.name: checkDBSettings
methods.description: Validates database configuration parameters, tests database connection, and checks for existing database and user conflicts during installation.

methods.name: printErrors
methods.description: Outputs validation errors or success message after database checks.

methods.name: copyInputsIntoSession
methods.description: Copies user input from request parameters into session variables for persistent configuration during installation.
